objects.name: Hunter Bram
objects.greeting: Quiet in the wood today. Too quiet.|I have hunted these trees thirty years. I never saw a bear that colour, nor that size.
objects.stock: arrow bundle x20, longbow, roast meat x4, leather x6, twine x8
objects.topics: The stones=Follow the path north and west. They stand in a ring, older than the wood.; The wood=Bandits camp east of the fork. Give them a wide berth, or do not.

objects.title: The blue bear
objects.offer: There is a bear among the old stones: blue as a kingfisher and half again the size of any I have seen. It has had two of my dogs. Put it down, and my best bow is yours.
objects.remind: The stone ring is north-west, where the path ends.
objects.thanks: Blue. I would not have believed it. A bargain is a bargain - she shoots true.
objects.reward: coins x120, longbow crafted x1, bear pelt x1

objects.contents: coins x60, dagger sharper, stamina potion x2
